kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
انفرثت (form VII)
# اِنْفَرَثْتُ (infaraṯtu) /in.fa.raθ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْفَرَثَ (infaraṯa)
# اِنْفَرَثْتَ (infaraṯta) /in.fa.raθ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْفَرَثَ (infaraṯa)
# اِنْفَرَثْتِ (infaraṯti) /in.fa.raθ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْفَرَثَ (infaraṯa)
# اِنْفَرَثَتْ (infaraṯat) /in.fa.ra.θat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
